title: Verify: SVG assets resolve with manifest dimensions unit tests
summary: Unit tests for the nine SVG manifest paths
description: Add game/tests/publicAssetSvgs.test.ts. It reads the real manifest.json and the static asset files read-only (no writes, no app, no network) and asserts each SVG path exists with matching dimensions.
acceptance_criteria: SVG root is svg with crispEdges
technical_constraints: vitest; resolve root as ../public/assets via import.meta.url

steps.action: Load manifest.json via readFileSync, filter assets whose path ends with .svg and starts with worlds/ (nine entries). Add it('every svg path exists under public/assets') asserting the missing-list equals []; it('svg width and height match manifest dimensions') parsing width="N" height="N" with a regex and comparing to asset.dimensions; it('svg is crispEdges') asserting the content contains '<svg' and 'shape-rendering="crispEdges"'.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/publicAssetSvgs.test.ts
